## Indexing guide

nextcli builds a local index of your code so retrieval stays fast.

## Embeddings

Each chunk is embedded once and cached by its content hash.

```
const index = await LanceDbIndex.create(provider, readFile);
```

## Docs sites

Docs are crawled, split by **h2** sections and embedded.

* Cheerio for static pages
* Chromium for apps that need JavaScript

## Limits

| Setting      | Default |
| ------------ | ------- |
| maxChunkSize | 512     |

## Release notes

This release replaces the vector store and keeps existing indexes readable.

Existing users do not need to re-embed anything; the migration copies rows.

See the changelog for the full list of fixes and the upgrade notes.
